entities.name: Ungern-Sternberg and Revolution of 1921
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Ungern-Sternberg and Revolution of 1921, a transformative movement in Mongolia (1920–1924). Emerged from People's Republic and Mongolian People's Republic proclaimed after the Bogd Khan's death. Catalyzed Sükhbaatar and Soviet forces liberate Urga from Ungern-Sternberg and Battle of Khalkhin Gol — Soviet-Mongolian forces defeat Japan.
